ios.desc:
# CLASSIC LITERATURE, HUMAN VOICES

Libris.fm brings the world's literary treasures to your ears through the warmth of human narration. Discover thousands of free audiobooks from the public domain ( Librivox and internet archive), read by volunteer narrators from around the world.

## THE HUMAN TOUCH

In an age of AI, we celebrate authentic human voices. Every recording in our collection is narrated by a real person who donated their time and talent. Experience the subtle emotion, unique pacing, and authentic connection that only human narration can provide.

## COMPLETELY FREE

• No subscriptions
• No ads
• No tracking

## FEATURES

• Simple, intuitive interface
• Background playback
• Variable playback speed
• Skip forward/backward controls
• Curated collections


## EXTENSIVE LIBRARY

Explore a collection spanning centuries of human thought and creativity:

• Fiction classics
• Poetry
• Drama
• Philosophy
• History
• Science
• Children's literature
• Religious texts
• And much more

From timeless classics to forgotten gems, Libris.fm exists to make great literature accessible to everyone through the spoken word.

Made with love for book lovers everywhere. Join us in preserving and sharing our literary heritage through the power of human voices.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I'm the creator of Libris.fm. I've been a long-time fan of audiobooks, especially classic literature found in the public domain. I wanted a simple, dedicated app to listen to these works narrated by real people, without any distractions.

Libris.fm brings together over 10,000 human-narrated audiobooks, primarily sourced from LibriVox and the Internet Archive.

Key points:

Completely Free: No subscriptions or paywalls.

No Ads & No Tracking: Built with privacy in mind. Just the books.

Human Narration: Focused specifically on volunteer-read recordings, not synthetic voices.

Simple Interface: Includes essentials like background playback, speed adjustment, and skip controls.

Content: Lots of classic literature, poetry, history, drama, etc. Please checkout the discover screen and see for yourself.

This was a passion project born out of my love for literature and a belief that these public domain works deserve to be easily accessible. It's not trying to be an Audible or Spotify competitor, but rather a focused tool for enjoying these specific types of audiobooks.

It's currently available here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/h-for-hacker-news/id6744145932

I'm actively developing it and would genuinely appreciate any feedback from the HN community – feature requests, bug reports, or general thoughts are all welcome!

quotes.text:
I built Libris.fm[1] , it's a free iOS app written in swift which gives access to users for 10000+ free audiobooks.

The app is objectively better than many popular apps in this segment which have a paywall and tons of ads. However i hardly get any downloads since the launch.

I have tried posting in r/audiobooks[2] and got some decent feedback. But I don't have any other clue on how to get more users for the app.

I don't have any monetization plan other than an optional tip jar that I have placed in the app.

Looking for advice on how to make more users aware of the app. This is a side project and I don't have any maketing budget as an indie developer.

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/libris-fm-free-audiobooks/id6744654703
[2] https://www.reddit.com/r/audiobooks/comments/1k48lzb/librisfm_10000_free_audiobooks_with_human/
